rationale: The workflow repeatedly downloads and compiles Cargo dependencies on every run (cargo check/clippy/test across multiple feature combinations) with no existing cache. Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (observational evidence, reported vm-time reduction of 6% free / 3.4% paid) supports caching dependency download state keyed on the lockfile and environment while keeping all required checks. The change adds an actions/cache step for ~/.cargo/registry and ~/.cargo/git, keyed on runner.os and hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') with a prefix restore key. All original build/test steps and permissions are preserved unchanged; only dependency download state is cached, not unchecked build outputs, matching the pattern's method and avoiding its contraindications (no equivalent cache exists; crates.io content is immutable).
